independentExecution.executionIsolation: Copies and generated test outputs confined to reviewer workspace; author files unchanged.

guardsReviewed.exactSource: Full 40-character source revision, exact named branch head check before build and before publish/finalize, ancestry check, artifact identity/digest verification and exact live HTML/assets revision and SHA-256 verification retained.
guardsReviewed.credentiallessBuild: Separate build and publish jobs retained. No provider secrets in build or finalization-only job, and source checkout does not persist credentials.
guardsReviewed.providerReadback: Only fixed account, Worker inventory and domains inventory GETs permitted for preflight/readback. Initial target must be absent; ambiguous, incomplete, foreign and colliding inventories fail closed.
guardsReviewed.noOverride: Only fixed hostname attachment PUT is allowed, with override_scope, override_existing_origin and override_existing_dns_record all false; other DNS/security/provider mutations are blocked.
guardsReviewed.http403: IndexNow 403 is journaled as rejected. Same-fingerprint re-entry is blocked by indexnow_403_diagnostic_review_required and performs no second POST.
guardsReviewed.unknownTerminal: Uncertain timeout, started or unknown receipt outcomes block a second POST. Accepted 200/202 receipts are reused, preserving pending-validation distinction.
guardsReviewed.exactLiveBeforeSubmission: Full public verification and unchanged sitemap are required before journal start and each POST; changed public source submits zero requests.
guardsReviewed.approvedOnlyAssembly: Exact article, frozen-plan and coverage hashes bind independent content review; approved/deferred partition and >=90%/minimum-three thresholds enforced; synthetic review cannot invoke production assembler.
guardsReviewed.geographicSeparation: Full official membership retained separately from unique one-unit-per-page frozen purchase-intent plan; held routes remain reserved and unrepresented units are not fabricated.
guardsReviewed.safeOutput: Production assembler refuses existing source output, rejects synthetic-only review, creates output atomically and retains fresh customer snapshots and new ownership/provenance.
